title: Corner Lasers
concept: Seamline, a business account for freelancers: three hairline lasers — invoices in, tax reserve, pay yourself — run along the seams of a room corner and meet at one white-hot emitter, with lime haze pooling from the junction behind the hero and a statement and pricing section carrying the same seam language.
notes: Raw WebGL fragment shader, no libraries: line-distance falloff per ray (≈1 css px white core, accent halo + volume), traveling energy packets, fbm haze and wall/ceiling plane shading tinted from --accent, emitter bloom + horizontal streak, exp tone-map. Beam labels are DOM chips placed along the same ray geometry. Renders only while the hero is visible; reduced motion draws one still frame; no WebGL falls back to a CSS radial emitter.
